blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: partition — Place smaller/larger values around pivot.
worst case — Maximum growth for adverse input.

blocks.title: Observe
blocks.text: Partitioning reorders values around a chosen pivot so values to its left are no larger and those right are larger, for this partition rule.

blocks.title: Apply
blocks.text: The pivot's final index is fixed after partition, but neither side is necessarily fully sorted; quicksort continues with the two subarrays.

blocks.title: Evaluate
blocks.text: Average and best-case time O(n log n), worst O(n²) with poor pivot choices; recursion consumes stack space depending on partition balance.
